nsw-foundation-spatial-data-framework-el.title: NSW Foundation Spatial Data Framework - Elevation and Depth - Point Cloud

resources.name: NSW Foundation Spatial Data Framework - Elevation and Depth - Point Cloud

nsw-foundation-spatial-data-framework-el.notes: The point cloud data set consists of point clouds captured from LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and derived from airborne imagery using photogrammetric techniques.

nsw-foundation-spatial-data-framework-el.title: NSW Foundation Spatial Data Framework - Elevation and Depth - NSW Contours

resources.name: NSW Foundation Spatial Data Framework - Elevation and Depth Theme - NSW Contours

nsw-foundation-spatial-data-framework-el.notes: Contours are virtual imaginary lines on the ground, joining points of an equal elevation in relation to the Australian Height Datum (AHD). A contour can be a standard contour, depression contour or an ancillary contour. It is a part of the NSW Digital Topographic Database (DTDB).

nsw-foundation-spatial-data-framework-el.title: NSW Foundation Spatial Data Framework - Elevation and Depth - NSW Relative Heights

resources.name: NSW Foundation Spatial Data Framework - Elevation and Depth Theme -NSW Relative Heights.pdf

nsw-foundation-spatial-data-framework-el.notes: Relative Height is a point feature class representing relative heights of a vertical face of a cliff. It is a part of the NSW Digital Topographic Database (DTDB).
